title: Salt Water Express
meta_description: Saltwater Express: 3BR condo in Blue Mountain Beach with private beach access, 2 pools, fitness center, and spacious balcony with gulf views.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Saltwater Express is a TOP FLOOR end unit in the gated community of Adagio which is located on the south side of Highway 30A in Blue Mountain Beach. It sits on a high dune bluff overlooking a large private stretch of pristine white beach.

The interior includes 10' ceilings, an arched hallway, granite counters and marble flooring that adds to the warm and welcome ambiance of this beautiful condo. The exterior is styled in Italian Mediterranean architecture and has lush tropical landscaping that adds to the inviting allure of the property.

The main pool is 8,000 square feet with three tiers connected by continuous waterfall features and incorporating a central fountain. Surrounded by spacious lounging decks and seating areas this pool is a delight to all who frequent Adagio. The heated gulf pool is perched at the edge of the dunes adjacent to the beach access. Additional amenities include an on-site fitness center with state-of-the-art exercise equipment, community room, private beach access with showers, and four separate outdoor Viking BBQ grilling areas.

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach has been awarded a national "Blue Wave" designation for the pristine cleanliness of the sugar sand shoreline. This coastal community rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park and is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you. Spend your mornings grabbing coffee and pastries from Blue Mountain Bakery and evenings strolling to dinner at Blue Mabel Restaurant, Mimmo's,or Basmati's Asian Cuisine. Don't forget to grab dessert, or better yet, don't wait for dessert! Stop by Blue Mountain Beach Creamery after your bike ride or day at the beach to find out why so many argue it's the best ice cream in town.

BEACH ACCESS: Private beach access

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King Bed with ensuite bath
• Bedroom 2 -- King Bed with ensuite bath
• Bedroom 3 -- Queen Bed

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Top Floor Condo
• Large Covered Balcony with outdoor seating
• 2 Community Pools
• Gated Community
• Community Grill
• Private Beach
• Fitness Center
• Self-Check-In
• Full linen package
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- There are no assigned parking spots.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.
